story_scenes.new_development: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Automate Pull Request Approval
receipt: Claude Ship consists of Code Review (generally available), PR Steward (beta), and Claude Approvals (beta).
Claude Approvals allows AI to merge code based on team-defined policies.
unknown: Not available to organizations using HIPAA-configured environments or customer-managed encryption keys.
Beta product; Anthropic recommends running in 'observe-only' mode initially.

story_scenes.new_development: Meta Launches Muse AI Agent for Personal Shopping in the UK
receipt: Muse launched in the UK on November 23, 2026, for users 18 and older.
The agent supports task execution across partners like Marks & Spencer, Ocado, and Trainline.
unknown: Prompt injection remains an acknowledged, open security challenge.
Initial launch is limited to the UK market.

receipt: Google DeepMind published the research post on November 23, 2026.
The work used teams of Gemini 4 agents.
unknown: This is research, not a public consumer product.
The article does not claim deployed commercial availability.
